description: [SHOM-IGN] trait de côte _ Histolitt® is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The coastline corresponds to the high seas leash in the case of an astronomical tide of 120 coefficient and under normal weather conditions (no offshore wind, no atmospheric depression likely to raise sea level). The TCH product models this theoretical entity by a set of 2D polylines. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "[SHOM-IGN] Coastline _ Histolitt®" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OCCITANIE, trait de côte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
